visual_selection: every cultivar for observed common EXIF 0/1/6/8 tags plus one deterministic hash-selected record per other observed tag; all observed tags and cultivars represented
EXIF_identity_note: Tag 1 includes the default used if EXIF orientation is absent. Tag 0 is undefined in EXIF and was retained in native coordinates only after exact JSON dimension and bbox checks. No rotation was guessed.
visual_review_status: All 20 prespecified pairs were visually checked by the author, who found the same annotated apple retained in each crop; this is sample-based visual validation, not certification of all physical measurement pairings.
